_note: Chapter 2 dialogue, zh source kept for traceability; runtime reads en.

events.trigger_zh: 登陆整队，敌军尚未接近

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 船板上的刻记，和那件遗物一样。
lines.en: That mark on the hull's the same as the one on the relic.

lines.speaker: Ferryman
lines.zh: 先帮我们把岸上的人接回来。你们要找的船，我见过。
lines.en: Help us get our people off the beach first. I've seen that ship you're after.

events.trigger_zh: 两名渡夫救助完成、最后追兵清除

lines.speaker: Ferryman
lines.zh: 就是这道刻记。船不进海门，只在盐田换货。
lines.en: That's the mark. Those ships never put in at Seagate, they just trade at the saltpans.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 你能带我们去吗？
lines.en: Can you take us there?

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 他要先回家。盐田那边也不是给外人查案的地方。
lines.en: He's going home first, and the saltpans aren't open to outsiders asking questions anyway.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 那边还有人没撤出来，我们能帮忙。
lines.en: You've still got people out there, and we can help.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 我只给你们沿岸通行的旗，不给你们调兵的权。
lines.en: I'll give you a flag for the coast road. You don't get to order my soldiers around.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 够了。先把人接回来。
lines.en: That'll do. Let's get those people back first.

events.trigger_zh: 首次与陆绫会合、尚未进入桥上接战

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 上桥还能走，下桥的芦苇里有东西。
lines.en: The upper bridge is still clear, but there's something in the reeds past the lower one.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 你替我们看住下游，人先过河。
lines.en: Watch the downstream side. We'll get the people across.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 我是朔岛的骑哨，岛上的回信断了半个月。
lines.en: I'm an outrider out of the North Isle. I haven't had word from home in two weeks.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 你回不去？
lines.en: You can't get back?

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 海门不给船。那边若还守着，等的就是我这封信。
lines.en: Seagate won't give me a boat. So if the isle's still holding, they're waiting on a letter I can't deliver.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 我们先追粮车。找到航路，就替你把信送到。
lines.en: We're chasing the grain carts first. Once we find a sea lane, we'll get your letter through.

events.trigger_zh: 祠前清场后，首次仪式前

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 这些尸体不是自己醒的。有人在远处牵着。
lines.en: These bodies didn't wake on their own. Someone's pulling them from a distance.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 我们挡住来路，你先救还能救的人。
lines.en: We'll hold the approach. Get to the ones you can still save.

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 你们带来的刻记，和这些魂印的接法很像。
lines.en: That mark of yours is tied off the same way these soul-seals are.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 是同一个法师？
lines.en: The same necromancer?

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 只凭这个还认不得。教过同一种术，也能留下同样的线。
lines.en: I can't tell from this alone. Anyone trained in the same craft leaves the same threads.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 那就先查运它们的人。船总要靠岸，货总要入账。
lines.en: Then we start with whoever ships them. Boats have to land somewhere, and cargo has to go in a ledger.

events.trigger_zh: 准备期，风术师到位且技能可用

lines.speaker: Qinghe
lines.zh: 看弓队的朝向。我能接住这一面的来箭，另一侧得靠你们。
lines.en: Watch which way their archers face. I can stop the arrows on this side, but the other side's yours.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 守住内院，别追出门去。南面的路也留人。
lines.en: Hold the inner yard and don't chase them out the gate. Leave some men on the south road too.

events.trigger_zh: 首次箭雨演示结束且当前敌人清除

lines.speaker: Qinghe
lines.zh: 风障散了就移位，别在原地等下一轮。
lines.en: When the Wind Wall drops, move. Don't stand there waiting for the next volley.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 弓队交给侧翼；前排先收回来。
lines.en: Flanks, take the archers. Front rank, pull back.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 海门守住了。你们要的通行文书，在这里。
lines.en: Seagate held. Here's the pass you wanted.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 只到江城？
lines.en: Only as far as the River City?

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 我守的是这座门，不能替所有人许诺援军。
lines.en: I only hold this gate, so I can't promise you other men's soldiers.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 我们也不是来借走你们最后一支兵的。
lines.en: We didn't come to take your last company either.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 那就把粮路接上。江城若能喘口气，才谈得上出海。
lines.en: Then get the grain moving again. Once the River City can breathe, we can talk about ships.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 好。明早沿河走。
lines.en: Good. We'll go upriver at first light.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 两边的船都得卸，别把人全压在一个口子。
lines.en: Both boats have to be unloaded, so don't bunch everyone at one landing.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 先清靠岸这边，再接另一船。
lines.en: Clear this side first, then bring the other one in.

lines.speaker: Boatman
lines.zh: 这几天运来的箱子，封泥和粮箱一样，分量却不对。
lines.en: Crates came in all week. They're sealed like grain, but the weight's wrong.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 留下封泥，去上游粮仓核账。
lines.en: Keep one of those seals. We'll check the books at the granary upriver.

events.trigger_zh: 进入水车粮仓，尚未开工

lines.speaker: Granary Steward
lines.zh: 水轮还转得动，停的是运粮的船。
lines.en: The wheel still turns. It's the grain boats that stopped coming.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 工人分批走，我们留住磨坊。
lines.en: Move the workers out in groups. We'll keep the mill.

events.trigger_zh: 工人与粮物送达安全点

lines.speaker: Granary Steward
lines.zh: 有人在驿站换过运单，连军粮也被划去了铳坊。
lines.en: Someone swapped the manifests at the post. Even army grain got signed over to the gunworks.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 先去驿站，别让假账再带我们绕路。
lines.en: We'll head for the post station next. I'm done with forged books sending us the long way round.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 北面的旗手在找信号点。让他吹响，援兵会提前到。
lines.en: Their flagman's hunting for a signal point up north. If he sounds it, their reinforcements get here early.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 你看住他，我们去取原账。
lines.en: You keep him in sight. We'll get the real ledger.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 粮船装过骨灯，下一站是军械工坊。
lines.en: The grain boats were carrying bone lamps, so the gunworks is our next stop.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 我先去探路。
lines.en: I'll scout ahead.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 看见烟也别独自进去，那地方不缺火药。
lines.en: If you see smoke, don't go in alone. That place is full of powder.

lines.speaker: Xu Heng
lines.zh: 先救人和图册！别往火药棚那边走。
lines.en: Get the people and the drawings out first! Keep away from the powder shed!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 西门能开吗？
lines.en: Can you open the west gate?

lines.speaker: Xu Heng
lines.zh: 能，门里还有一排铳。我们压住外院，你们接匠人。
lines.en: Yes, and there's a rack of guns behind it. We'll hold the outer yard, you get the smiths.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 先把人送过井边，枪和账箱都跟着走。
lines.en: Get them past the well, and bring the guns and the ledger box too.

events.trigger_zh: 许衡和匠人撤出并清场

lines.speaker: Xu Heng
lines.zh: 制式铳先给你们。保下的五雷和重管还能凑两组，到了江城才能按图普遍整备。
lines.en: The Matchlocks are yours. I saved two Five Thunders and two Heavy Muskets, but proper kit waits for the River City.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 五雷就是一口气打五发？
lines.en: So the Five Thunders fires five shots at once?

lines.speaker: Xu Heng
lines.zh: 一发一发打。前面快，打空以后慢。
lines.en: One at a time. It's fast while it's loaded and slow once it's empty.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 重管呢？
lines.en: And the heavy one?

lines.speaker: Xu Heng
lines.zh: 每发都重，节奏也匀。弹要选对，打成群的和打铁甲的不是一回事。
lines.en: Every shot hits hard at a steady rhythm. Pick the right round, though. Crowds and armor need different ones.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 那就两样都留。先把会造它们的人带回去。
lines.en: We'll take both. And the man who builds them comes with us.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 江口那具水尸被叫作赢勾。别追进水里，干码头能绕过去。
lines.en: They call that drowned thing at the river mouth Yinggou. Don't chase it into the water, just go round the dry wharf.

lines.speaker: Xu Heng
lines.zh: 枪交给我的人，给他们留装填的空地。
lines.en: Give the guns to my men, and give them room to reload.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 顾廷舟的运单……封港的船，也是他的。
lines.en: These are Gu Tingzhou's manifests. The ships blockading the port are his too.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 江城的粮、骨灯、铁关的守军，全走一条水路。
lines.en: The city's grain, the bone lamps, the men holding the Iron Pass. It's all one water route.

lines.speaker: Xu Heng
lines.zh: 铳坊失火前，他的人还催着我们交货。
lines.en: His people were still pushing us for delivery right before the gunworks burned.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 可江城现在连给北岛送信的船都凑不齐。
lines.en: And the River City can't scrape together one boat to carry word to the North Isle.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 先开铁关，把军需送去东北港。陆绫说岛上有船队。
lines.en: We'll open the Iron Pass and run the supplies to the northeast port. Lu Ling says the isle has a fleet.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 岛军若也被围住了呢？
lines.en: And if the island garrison is under siege too?

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 我们带着粮和军械去，不空着手求他们。
lines.en: We'll arrive with grain and weapons, so we're not begging empty-handed.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 我派人同行。江城的事，也不能一直让外人做。
lines.en: I'm sending men with you. Outsiders can't keep doing this city's work.

lines.speaker: Forgemaster
lines.zh: 炉还热着。守住三趟活，陌刀就能交到你们手上。
lines.en: Forge is still hot. Cover three runs of work and I'll have the Great Glaives ready for you.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 先让刀盾接散兵，长刀站后半步。
lines.en: Sword and shield, take the loose ones. Long blades, stay half a step back.

lines.speaker: Forgemaster
lines.zh: 那辆撞木车冲的是炉，不是人。正面铁板别硬啃。
lines.en: That Battering Ram's after the forge, not us. Don't waste your time on the front plate.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 留一队看炉，两侧打车架。谁也别挤在撞木前头。
lines.en: Keep one squad on the forge and hit the frame from the sides. Nobody stands in front of that beam.

events.trigger_zh: 三段炉务完成、威胁清除

lines.speaker: Forgemaster
lines.zh: 刀刃够重，出手就别乱转。等它自己撞上来。
lines.en: The blade's heavy enough on its own. Don't swing it around, just let them walk onto it.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 先开关路，再让后面的车跟上。
lines.en: Open the pass road first, then bring the carts up.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 里面的守军还在。缺口一亮旗，他们就出手。
lines.en: The garrison inside is still alive. Show a flag at the breach and they'll move.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 先把原来的达思斧卫拉开，别让运料的人顶上去。
lines.en: Pull those Darth axemen off first. Don't let the supply crews take the hit.

lines.speaker: Pass Sergeant
lines.zh: 将臣就在门后，他每次举刃，护卫都会换阵。
lines.en: General Jiangchen is right behind the gate. Every time he raises that blade, his guards shift.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 等护卫动的时候进去，两边一起。
lines.en: We'll go in while the guards are moving, both sides at once.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 外面开路，里面接应。别挤进同一道门。
lines.en: We'll break in from outside while they push from within. Don't all pile into one gate.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 先压住护卫，给另一队留出侧面。
lines.en: Pin the guards. Leave the flank open for the other column.

events.trigger_zh: 将臣第二阶段结束且援兵暂歇

lines.speaker: Pass Sergeant
lines.zh: 它把最后一队全压到缺口了。
lines.en: It's thrown its last company at the breach.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 正面稳住，从空出来的侧路绕！
lines.en: Hold the front! Go round by the side road while it's empty!

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 东北港的船能走了，我想随第一船回岛。
lines.en: The northeast port can sail now. I want to be on the first boat home.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 你是带信的人，当然一起去。
lines.en: You're carrying the letter. Of course you're coming.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 关内守军需要留下，能带走的人不会很多。
lines.en: The pass garrison stays here, so we won't be taking many men with us.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 有粮和军械就够让他们知道，海门没忘记我们。
lines.en: Grain and weapons are enough to tell them Seagate hasn't forgotten us.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 也让他们知道，我们不是来要他们舍下家乡的。
lines.en: And that we're not asking anyone to give up their home.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 我把这句话写进文书。至于能不能结盟，还得你们自己去谈。
lines.en: I'll put that in writing. Whether it turns into an alliance is for you to argue out.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 这是我回乡的路。岸哨没有旗，不像是撤走了。
lines.en: This is my way home. There's no flag on the shore post, but it doesn't look like they pulled out either.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 先接住卸船的人，别把整队堵在栈桥上。
lines.en: Cover the unloading party. Don't jam the whole company on the pier.

lines.speaker: Island Sentry
lines.zh: 陆绫？你真从海门回来了？
lines.en: Lu Ling? You actually made it back from Seagate?

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 带了军需。岳将军在哪里？
lines.en: I brought supplies. Where's Commander Yue?

lines.speaker: Island Sentry
lines.zh: 西港。马场和烽台都断了，我们等不到他的旗。
lines.en: West harbor. The ranch and the beacon are both cut off, so we never see his flag.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 先把卸货的人接上岸，我去把路找回来。
lines.en: Get the cargo crews ashore. I'll find the road back.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 灯还亮着，雾却从灯下往外走。那不是我们的信号。
lines.en: The lamp's still lit, but the fog is rolling out from under it. That's not our signal.

lines.speaker: Qinghe
lines.zh: 先找灯架，不要追雾里的人影。
lines.en: Find the lamp frame. Don't chase shapes in the fog.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 回旗了！是西港的旗。
lines.en: They answered! That's the west harbor's flag.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 他们要我们往哪里走？
lines.en: Where do they want us?

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 马场。开栏的人被困着，马一散，西岬就再也接不到援兵。
lines.en: The ranch. The gate crew's trapped, and if the horses scatter, West Cape gets no relief at all.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 回他一句：人和马，我们都去接。
lines.en: Signal back. We're coming for the people and the horses.

lines.speaker: Ranch Guard
lines.zh: 堤边有骨蛛拉的索，快马也得先看脚下。
lines.en: Tripwire Spiders have lines strung along the bank. Watch your footing, however fast your horse is.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 我去探桩，你们护住开栏的人。
lines.en: I'll check the stakes. You cover the gate crew.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 别只顾跑得快，退路也要留出来。
lines.en: Don't just ride fast. Keep a way back open.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 马还在，骑哨就能重新跑起来。西岬的路我熟。
lines.en: We've still got horses, so the couriers can ride again. I know the road to West Cape.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 先报清敌情，不用你一个人冲开它。
lines.en: Report what's out there first. You don't have to open it alone.

events.trigger_zh: 重骑出现前的安全观察点

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 黑甲和我们见过的达思骑士一样，可这次骑着马。
lines.en: Same black armor as the Darth knights, only these ones are mounted.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 别追着砍。陌刀朝来路立住，让铳手留在后面。
lines.en: Don't chase them. Glaives, face the road and hold. Gunners, stay behind them.

lines.speaker: Yue Cen
lines.zh: 你们带来的粮，我收到了。马场的人也回来了。
lines.en: I got the grain you brought. My ranch hands are back as well.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 船队能借给我们吗？海对面还有人在等援军。
lines.en: Can you lend us the fleet? There are people across the sea waiting on relief.

lines.speaker: Yue Cen
lines.zh: 西港还被后卿压着。我若把船开走，岛上剩下的人怎么办？
lines.en: Houqing still has the west harbor by the throat. If I sail the fleet off, what happens to the rest?

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 我们刚才守住了西岬。再往前一步，就能把他们接到港里。
lines.en: We just held West Cape. One more push and we can bring them into the harbor.

lines.speaker: Yue Cen
lines.zh: 我信你，陆绫。可这次要留下谁，不能靠你一个人答应。
lines.en: I trust you, Lu Ling. But who stays behind isn't yours alone to promise.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 那就先不谈借船。把港口打通，人都接齐再谈。
lines.en: Then forget the ships for now. We'll open the harbor and get everyone in, then we talk.

lines.speaker: Yue Cen
lines.zh: 你们真愿意再打一场？
lines.en: You'd really fight another one?

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 我们已经走到这里了。不会把人留在岸上。
lines.en: We came this far. We're not leaving people on the shore.

lines.speaker: Yue Cen
lines.zh: 后卿借咒旗和尸体拖我们。旗能打，尸也能封。
lines.en: Houqing drags this out with hex banners and corpses. We can cut the banners down and lay the dead to rest.

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 我先顾最近的一具，别等所有尸体都堆起来。
lines.en: I'll take the nearest body first. Don't wait for them to pile up.

lines.speaker: Yue Cen
lines.zh: 岛上各营都回旗了。船队、骑哨和军需，我出。
lines.en: Every camp on the isle has answered. I'll provide the fleet, the outriders and the supplies.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 那我们能一起回海门了？
lines.en: So we sail for Seagate together?

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 先看这本船账。送来骨灯的船，都是从阴江出来的。
lines.en: Look at this shipping ledger first. Every boat that brought bone lamps came out of the Shadow River.

lines.speaker: Yue Cen
lines.zh: 如果现在就走，这里很快又会被封上。
lines.en: If we leave now, they'll close this place off again soon enough.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 我们想救自己的大陆，不能把另一片留给同样的灾难。
lines.en: We came to save our own land, but we're not leaving this one to the same thing.

lines.speaker: Yue Cen
lines.zh: 所以先往西渡。我留人守岛，亲自带一部随你们去。
lines.en: West first, then. I'll leave a force on the isle and bring the rest with you myself.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 这回不用我一个人送信了。
lines.en: I won't be carrying word alone this time.

lines.speaker: Yue Cen
lines.zh: 这回你送的，是两边都认的旗。
lines.en: This time you're carrying a banner that both sides answer to.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 岸边没有脚印，树上却有抓痕。
lines.en: No footprints on the bank, but there are claw marks up in the trees.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 后排留空地。看清它从哪儿起跳。
lines.en: Keep the back rank clear. Watch where it jumps from.

lines.speaker: Messenger
lines.zh: 沉村的人还活着，有人不许他们离开河边。
lines.en: There are still people alive in the sunken village. Someone won't let them leave the river.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 是守军？
lines.en: Soldiers?

lines.speaker: Messenger
lines.zh: 押船的活人，和看住他们的死人。账簿在这里，我带你们去。
lines.en: Living men run the boats and dead ones watch the villagers. I've got the ledger. I'll take you there.

lines.speaker: Qinghe
lines.zh: 水是被堰门截走的，污物顺着另一道渠进来。
lines.en: The weir gate is holding the water back. The filth comes in down the other channel.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 分开转两处绞盘，别让工人站在来敌路上。
lines.en: Split up and work both winches. Keep the workers off the paths they're coming down.

events.trigger_zh: 两绞盘与祭台处理完毕

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 傀儡背的锚架，和断碑寺留下的图形同形。
lines.en: The anchor frame those puppets carry matches the figures at the Temple of the Broken Stele.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 寺里的人也在帮他们？
lines.en: The temple's people are helping them?

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 未必。同一口钟能报平安，也能被拿去号令死人。
lines.en: Maybe not. The monks there ring that bell for the all-clear, but someone else could be using it on the dead.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 去找懂它的人。人证和原文，总比猜测可靠。
lines.en: Let's find someone who can read it. I'd rather have a witness and the original text than guesses.

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 木铃能安一具，挡不住成片引魂。这口铜铃可以把链接断开。
lines.en: The Wooden Bell only settles one body, so it can't stop soul-calling on this scale. This bronze one cuts the link.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 你读碑，我们守三条路。
lines.en: You read the stele. We'll hold the three roads.

events.trigger_zh: 碑文读完、最后敌人清除

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 碑上记的是收殓护魂，他们却把线反接，拿尸体当货物拖走。
lines.en: The stele is about burying the dead and guarding the soul. They've reversed it and now they haul bodies off as cargo.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 所以铜铃能把整条线断开？
lines.en: So the bronze bell can cut the whole line?

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 能断一段，不能隔着一条河把所有人救回来。
lines.en: Only a stretch of it. I can't reach across a river and bring everyone back.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 至少杀掉的敌人不会白杀。
lines.en: At least the dead we put down won't get up again.

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 活着的人也还要顾。让我只追着尸体摇铃，我就顾不上前排了。
lines.en: The living still need me. If I'm off chasing corpses with a bell, nobody's tending the front rank.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 明白。治疗的人照旧留着，你去断最要紧的一条。
lines.en: Understood. The healers stay where they are, and you cut the line that matters most.

lines.speaker: Old Weir-Keeper
lines.zh: 顾廷舟改了货单，也改了水路。真账在塔里。
lines.en: Gu Tingzhou changed the manifests and the waterways both. The real books are up in the tower.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 你带我们找账，撤退的路由我们守。
lines.en: Take us to the books. We'll keep the way out open.

lines.speaker: Old Weir-Keeper
lines.zh: 他给海外的法师送骨灯，回船卸的却是铁甲亡灵。
lines.en: He shipped bone lamps out to a mage overseas, and the boats came back unloading armored dead.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 你亲眼见过那个法师？
lines.en: You saw this mage yourself?

lines.speaker: Old Weir-Keeper
lines.zh: 没有。我只管水闸，见过船、货和押运的文书。
lines.en: No. I mind the sluice gates. I saw boats, cargo, and the papers that went with them.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 文书上的刻记，我们在海对面也见过。
lines.en: We've seen the mark on those papers on the other side of the sea.

lines.speaker: Old Weir-Keeper
lines.zh: 顾廷舟还说，这条生意没人敢查到两头。
lines.en: Gu Tingzhou used to say nobody would dare trace this trade to both ends.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 现在两头的人都在这里了。
lines.en: Well, people from both ends are standing here now.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 原账带走，别让证人独自上路。
lines.en: Take the original books, and nobody walks the witness out alone.

lines.speaker: Old Weir-Keeper
lines.zh: 还有上游那三处阵眼。它们不停，河就回不来。
lines.en: We have to shut down the three soul-calling foci upstream before the river comes back.

lines.speaker: Qinghe
lines.zh: 旱魃站在干渠中，热地会换位置。给队伍留两条退路。
lines.en: Hanba stands in the dry channel, and the hot ground keeps shifting. Leave the squads two ways out.

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 灯线能断，阵眼也能直接拆。别等我一个人。
lines.en: We can cut the lamp lines or just tear the foci down. Don't wait on me for it.

events.trigger_zh: 第二阵眼拆除、当前来敌清完

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 河上的灯灭了两处，港口那边还亮着。
lines.en: Two of the river lamps are out, but the ones at the harbor are still burning.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 港锚是另一张网。先把这里彻底断干净。
lines.en: The harbor anchors are a separate net. Finish cutting this one clean first.

lines.speaker: Old Weir-Keeper
lines.zh: 水回来了。可西港那些灯怎么还亮着？
lines.en: The water's back. So why are those lamps at the west harbor still lit?

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 港锚另有供引。这里断了，只是让它们再也借不到上游的尸体。
lines.en: The harbor anchors are fed from somewhere else. Cutting this one only stops them taking corpses from upstream.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 那就带着账去港口。先把人送进去，再让船出来。
lines.en: Then we'll take the books to the harbor. We get the people in first, then the ships out.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 西岸有人接应，我带路。
lines.en: We've got people on the west coast. I'll lead.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 港门有人接应，主街能走，仓院也能绕。
lines.en: There are men waiting at the port gate. Main street is open, or you can swing round the warehouse yard.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 让居民等我们清路，不用跟着往前冲。
lines.en: Tell the townsfolk to wait while we clear the road. They shouldn't follow us in.

events.trigger_zh: 证人、居民和账箱转移完成

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 三镇都有人赶来，可他们还不知道船在哪里集合。
lines.en: People are coming in from all three towns, and none of them know where the ships muster.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 旧烽路还能用。点起来，他们认得我们的旗。
lines.en: The old beacon line still works. Light it up and they'll recognize our flag.

lines.speaker: Xu Heng
lines.zh: 船坞也要人，我带匠人先过去。
lines.en: The shipyard needs hands. I'll take the smiths over now.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 各走一段，最后都在港里会合。别再让谁等不到回信。
lines.en: We'll each take a leg of it and meet at the harbor. Nobody else gets left waiting for word.

lines.speaker: Xu Heng
lines.zh: 五雷分两列装填，别一起打空。
lines.en: Five Thunders reload in two ranks. Don't run them all dry at once.

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 陌刀看南面，侧卫留住两边。人上船前，我们不退。
lines.en: Glaives, watch the south. Flank guards, hold both ends. Nobody steps back until the people are aboard.

events.trigger_zh: 末波清除、三批装船完成

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 最后一辆车也上去了，港口只剩那三座锚！
lines.en: Last cart's loaded! Only those three anchors left in the harbor!

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 大队先登船。留下能突击的，跟我去断后。
lines.en: Main body boards now. Anyone who can still charge comes with me and covers the rear.

lines.speaker: Gu Tingzhou
lines.zh: 两片大陆不认彼此的旗，倒都肯收我的货。
lines.en: Two continents won't salute each other's flags, yet both take my cargo.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 你的货里有人，有被拖走的尸体。
lines.en: Your cargo has people in it, and bodies you dragged off.

lines.speaker: Gu Tingzhou
lines.zh: 你以为没有我，这些亡灵就会消失？海对面的法师也不是我造出来的。
lines.en: You think the dead go away without me? I didn't make the mage across the sea either.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 我们追的是他，今天先断你的船路。
lines.en: He's the one we're after. Today we cut your shipping lanes.

lines.speaker: Gu Tingzhou
lines.zh: 把锚拆了，你们也留不住所有人。
lines.en: Break the anchors if you like. You still won't keep everyone.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 那就一个一个带走。我们一路都是这么过来的。
lines.en: Then we'll get them out one at a time. That's how we've done it the whole way.

events.trigger_zh: 三锚全毁、首领击败、残敌清除

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 港上的灯都灭了，所有船都能离岸。
lines.en: Every lamp in the harbor is out, so all the ships can sail.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 带上账簿，回启航点。我们的仗打完了。
lines.en: Bring the ledgers. Back to the launch point. Our fight here's done.

events.trigger_zh: 启航区结算、战斗已结束

lines.speaker: Yue Cen
lines.zh: 东沧的船、人和军械，都在这支船队里。你们要的援军到了。
lines.en: Dongcang's ships, men and weapons are all in this fleet. Here's the relief you came for.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 西岸留下的守军呢？
lines.en: What about the garrison left on the west coast?

lines.speaker: Shen Li
lines.zh: 烽路和粮路都通了。他们守得住，我也会回来。
lines.en: The beacon line and the grain road are open. They'll hold, and I'm coming back.

lines.speaker: Lu Ling
lines.zh: 海门还有封没送到的回信，这回总算能亲手交了。
lines.en: There's a reply still sitting at Seagate. This time I get to hand it over myself.

lines.speaker: Xu Heng
lines.zh: 先让我看看你们那边的工坊。不同的铳弹，得找能造它的人。
lines.en: Let me see your workshops first. Different rounds need someone who can actually make them.

lines.speaker: Huizhao
lines.zh: 也替船上的伤员留一间干净舱室。
lines.en: And keep one clean cabin for the wounded.

lines.speaker: Yue Cen
lines.zh: 这些到了海对面再慢慢商量。现在，两家的旗一起升。
lines.en: We can settle all that on the other side. Right now both flags go up together.

lines.speaker: Captain
lines.zh: 升旗，启航。
lines.en: Flags up. Make sail.
